one step before, already penetrating but below limit with vx unchanged showing no bounce

counterfactual.change: reduced initial vx from 2.684 to 0.5 (one field) so body never reaches right boundary in 194 steps; failure disappears

explanation: Ball drifts right and penetrates the right arena boundary without any bounce impulse: vx stays ~2.717 from step 190 through 194 while x+r-20 grows from ~0 to 0.178. Rendered frames show ball progressively outside the black border. Likely cause is missed discrete boundary collision at shallow grazing contact near the floor (y-r ~0.1) — no reflection applied, so integration carries it through and in_arena tolerance is exceeded at step 194.
vision_note: The red ball at the bottom-right corner moves progressively rightward into the arena's right border from step 191 to 194. By step 194 it is visibly protruding outside the black border with no bounce or inward reflection.
